t: A tiny-power STM32 chip family for battery sensors and segment LCD gadgets.
steps: Buy a NUCLEO-U083RC from the ST eStore for about 13 US dollars.
Add the STM32duino board package in the Boards Manager.
Plug the board into your computer with a USB-C cable.
Pick the Nucleo-64 board and the U083RC chip in the Tools menu.
Upload the Blink example and watch the light flash.
Try the STM32U083C-DK kit later for segment LCD projects.
